front.title: Post-Quantum Algorithm Binding for SCITT Transparency Receipts
front.workgroup: Supply Chain Integrity, Transparency, and Trust

abstract.t: This document specifies how Supply Chain Integrity, Transparency, and Trust (SCITT) transparency receipts bind to post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) signing-algorithm metadata. The binding enables a downstream verifier to prove that a software supply-chain artifact was signed with a NIST-approved PQC suite at a specific rotation epoch.

The mechanism extends the SCITT receipt format with a pqc_binding header parameter and defines verifier processing rules. Concrete acceptance policies for PQC suites are deployment-specific and are not disclosed in this Internet-Draft.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: Software supply-chain artifacts are increasingly required to be signed with PQC-approved algorithms. SCITT transparency receipts must carry sufficient algorithm and epoch metadata to enable downstream verification.

section.name: Terminology
section.t: The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "SHOULD", "MAY" in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 [RFC2119] [RFC8174] when, and only when, they appear in all capitals, as shown here.

section.name: Receipt Header Parameter
section.t: The pqc_binding header parameter is a CBOR map carrying algorithm_identifier, rotation_epoch_id, and issuer_policy_uri fields. Receipts compliant with this document MUST include the parameter.

section.name: Verifier Processing
section.t: A verifier MUST check that algorithm_identifier is in the verifier's accepted-suite set and that rotation_epoch_id is not less than the verifier's configured minimum epoch.

section.name: Acceptance Policy
section.t: Concrete acceptance policies, including suite preference lists and minimum epochs, are deployment-specific and are not disclosed in this Internet-Draft.

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: The binding does not weaken the underlying SCITT integrity guarantees. Verifiers SHOULD reject receipts with unknown or revoked algorithm identifiers.

section.name: IANA Considerations
section.t: IANA is requested to allocate a header parameter for pqc_binding in the SCITT receipt header registry.
